verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents an official Mail MCP server that connects the inbox and calendar to Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants. Through it, an agent can summarize threads, read, draft and send email (with explicit approval for each send), and handle follow-ups end to end. The probe confirms the MCP server page exists. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that external agents can triage through the connection (labeling or archiving via MCP), tool-level or protocol documentation for custom agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
